Oracle has issued a force majeure notice on power supply to the project developer, a unit of Blue Owl Capital, after permitting delays amid rising local opposition, according to people cited by the FT.
Under the contract, Oracle must still pay a carry cost in lieu of rent for up to three years if the project misses its first-phase deadline.

Business Insider obtained a document listing the job titles and ages of 546 employees laid off from Oracle's America Cloud Infrastructure organisation.
Software developer III was the hardest-hit title, followed by program manager IV and principal core infrastructure engineer; developers made up around 17% of cuts.
41 roles came from data center support services, including that division's vice president; Oracle said the document was provided to comply with federal age discrimination laws.
Google says Project Suncatcher is scheduled for its first orbital test, with the first TPUs going into orbit next week.
A prototype satellite built with partner Planet will fly on SpaceX's Transporter-18 rideshare.
The test will evaluate how Google's Tensor Processing Units perform in space.
